synopsis: Chapter 12 and the glossary consistently identify ISO 16290:2013 as the standard for technology readiness levels (TRLs) [f9512, f14686]. TRLs measure maturity on a scale from 1 to 9, from a basic idea or basic principles to a system proven in real operation [f14684, f15336]. The glossary adds that the standard defines TRLs for space systems and standardizes their assessment criteria, while the scale originated at NASA [f14684, f14686, f15336]. It distinguishes ISO 16290 from ISO 18571 for curve agreement and ISO 25119 for functional safety on farm-machine control systems; these facts do not explain how the space-system TRL framework is adapted to the off-road braking project [f15330, f14684, f9512].
